title: Petal brain receipt v1
description: One serving of the brain's text by a door (research/brain-departments-2026-11-11.md, section 3; Elco, 11 Nov: "keep it exactly like harness does"): the Harness's brain_access_log, field for field, with the brain version as its commit. Written the moment the door answers, never rewritten; every count is worked out from these.

id.description: the receipt's id, returned to the caller as receipt

at.description: when the door answered (the Harness's created_at)

version.description: the brain version served, <index hash>@<commit> (the Harness's source_commit_sha)

keywords.description: what was asked: the question's words, as routing used them, and the calls the contract answers

matched_entries.description: what fired: the routing table's task rows and the departments reached

served_docs.description: the ids of the files served

chars_served.description: how many characters of the brain's text were served

core_doctrine.description: whether the doctrine was in it

client_id.description: the door: mcp, http, cli or site, or null when none said

client_label.description: the app's own name for itself, when its request says so

consumer_context.description: what it was read in: the run, job or exploration, and the subject (a person id or an anonymous handle), when there is one; null for none
